motivation: Hostile-review F-2 (Phase 2): the frozen C1 validated one synthetic positive plus false-positive controls but no parameter-recovery surface; an absence claim needs a sensitivity floor and direction/wavevector/frequency/velocity recovery verification over the operating inputs the estimator actually consumes.
separation_of_concerns: A-1a tests the ESTIMATOR ONLY (synthetic Phi with known parameters). It is not evidence that the neural model generates waves; the dynamical question is A-1b. Causal chain: geometry -> coupling/delay -> X(r,t) -> Q(r,t) -> Phi(r,t) -> W_hat; estimator last.

field_injection.formula: Phi(r,t) = A cos(k . r - omega t + phi0) + epsilon(r,t)
field_injection.spatial_coordinates: C3 ordered arc-length positions: x_i = R*theta_i, theta_i = 2*pi*i/N, R = ring_radius_mm, N = n_neurons; column vector shape (N,1) — identical to the estimator positions consumed by frozen C3
field_injection.substrate_note: synthetic field injected directly at the estimator input; no simulation involved

positive_lattice.design: grid over k (mode m and sign), frequency, phase offset, noise level; amplitude held at A=1.0 relative
positive_lattice.k_vector_rule: k = sign * m / R (rad per mm of arc length)
positive_lattice.noise: epsilon ~ N(0, sigma^2) per site per step, seeded rng
positive_lattice.fiducial_case: f=10.0 Hz, m=1, sign=+1, phi0=0, sigma=0

negative_controls.generator: planar_traveling_wave m=1 f=10 A=1 with Fisher-Yates permutation of site positions (seed=4242)

recovery_tolerances.origin: c0 convention, same spirit as C1 tolerances but extended
recovery_tolerances.direction_note: direction = sign of scalar k on the 1-D arc axis; canonicalized before angular error

pass_criteria.all_positive_cases: classification == TRAVELING_WAVE AND finite AND all recovery tolerances met
pass_criteria.all_negatives: classification == NO_WAVE (reason-level expectations recorded as findings; see D2)

validation_boundary: A-1a is estimator validation only; it does not certify that any neural regime produces a wave. A-1b addresses the dynamical side.

D1_frequency_recovery_on_cyclic_geometry.demonstration: ring m=1 f=10 synthetic wave on C3 arc positions: old estimator returned f_hat=9.5 (true 10.0) and k_hat=-0.987 (true +1.0) because integer ring modes have vanishing spatial mean trace, degenerating the mean-trace argmax; all downstream recovery (direction, velocity) corrupt
D1_frequency_recovery_on_cyclic_geometry.repair: _estimate_frequency_hz now argmaxes summed site power (total spectral power); identical to mean-trace spectrum for synchronous fields, well-defined for cancelling ring modes
D1_frequency_recovery_on_cyclic_geometry.mandate: user A-1a instruction: repair only on demonstrated genuine implementation defect

regression.c3_cells_60_60_identical: all 60 frozen C3 cells keep identical classification AND reason (52/4/4 mix) under repaired estimator
regression.c1_cases_7_7_identical: all 7 frozen C1 cases keep identical classification and reason

D2_standing_gate_parity_fragility.demonstration: the k-stability half-window flip gate fires on phasor degeneracy (off-resonance residue), not a standing signature; on the line geometry the standing control fired at even parity (T=2000) and missed at odd parity (T=1500, classified structured_but_fails); on the arc at exact carrier the halves produce stable-but-degenerate k_hat
D2_standing_gate_parity_fragility.safety_property: in every tested configuration the standing pattern classifies NO_WAVE (reason may differ: standing_or_flipping or structured_but_fails); the coherence/R2 gates are the backstop — a standing pattern has never been admitted as TRAVELING_WAVE in any test
D2_standing_gate_parity_fragility.reason: for real signals the +/-omega sidebands are Hermitian-equal, so no single-frequency phasor method can distinguish standing from traveling; a parity-independent standing discriminator would require a different estimator architecture outside A-1a scope
D2_standing_gate_parity_fragility.consequence: A-1a standing-wave negative asserts classification == NO_WAVE; reason-level expectation recorded as finding, not gate
